text:
isabel_cs: Hey team — Stormfall Risk submitted an onboarding request for a custom NER to extract claimant names, policy_numbers, and ICD/CPT codes. They emphasize PHI residency and want safety + deployment plan before renewal in ~5 weeks. Ping ENG/SAFETY/SRE. :wave:

kevin_eng: Quick clarifier — do they have span annotations (CoNLL/JSONL) or document tags? span JSONL is ideal. My default: try 7B quant on Dedicated first; only escalate to 13B if recall or PHI-leak tests fail.

isabel_cs: They have ~7.5k span-labeled records in JSONL (span offsets + label). Typical seq length ~280 tokens; peak 2.5 qps. Security: customer-managed KMS + HSM option requested. Contacts: am@stormfall.com (Noemi), ml@stormfall.com (Ibrahim).

rahul_safety: Need a formal PHI definition from them and data retention rules. Request a 150-record unredacted/redacted sample for leakage tests. Proposed gates: entity F1 >= 0.90 for core PHI labels; phi_leak_rate < 0.5% on validation. Also add adversarial prompt checks.

carmen_enable: I'll own onboarding: 60m workshop + checklist + demo notebook. Recommend attendees: AM, ML engineer, security. I'll prepare a short runbook covering redaction fallback and monitoring.

mia_sre: SRE sizing Qs — what's desired p95 latency? For ~3 qps and seqs <512, Dedicated 7B-quant with 1-2 A100s should hit p95 <500ms with small batching. Private deployment + HSM will need their infra spec (GPU model, network egress rules).

kevin_eng: Please have them upload a 200-sample (mixed redacted/unredacted) to a secure bucket and share the path. I'll run quick AB evals (7b-q vs 13b-fp16) and report entity-level F1 and phi_leak_rate. Example eval command for our infra:

```
redwood eval run --model redwood/7b-q --dataset s3://stormfall-onboard/ner_200_sample.jsonl \n  --metrics entity_f1,phi_leak_rate --output s3://cs-results/stormfall/7b_eval
```

rahul_safety: Safety checklist: redaction accuracy + fallback, per-label F1 with error slices, adversarial elicitation tests, and KMS/HSM audit. Blocker = any confirmed PHI egress or inability to use customer-managed keys.

carmen_enable: I'll prepare a validation checklist we can hand to their ML team and include a 20-record manual review step for edge cases.

isabel_cs: Sample path provided: s3://stormfall-onboard/secure/ner_200_sample.jsonl (shared to our VPC). I've opened Jira CS-8215 and added to renewal tracker. Can team do a sync Wed 10AM PT?

mia_sre: Wed 10AM PT works. I'll tentatively hold Dedicated capacity for the workshop week. If Stormfall commits reserved capacity we can optimize billing.

kevin_eng: I'll kick off AB runs once the sample is reachable. Plan: 200-example run for both models, produce per-label metrics and phi leak report, then recommend path. Expect results in ~48h.

rahul_safety: I'll add pass/fail criteria to CS-8215 and request a 25-record adversarial set flagged by Stormfall. Also add Console alert rules: SSN/Policy number regex detection and sampling for audit.

deploy-bot: Jira CS-8215 created: "Stormfall Risk - claims NER onboarding & PHI safeguards" — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-8215

isabel_cs: Thanks everyone — next steps: ENG run AB evals, SAFETY prepare adversarial & redaction tests, SRE confirm tentative capacity, ENABLE run workshop. Looping sales for the renewal conversation and marking high priority on renewal risk board. :lock:
